certificate.title: Module 4: Using AI to Improve Manual Tasks Completion

course.description: Use AI as your efficiency partner. Take any repetitive, manual task and make it dramatically faster — by having AI do the work, build a reusable tool, or redesign the process entirely. Apply the three-level improvement framework to your monthly close. Build a Finance Process Optimizer agent.
learningOutcomes: Apply the methods taught in Module 4: Using AI to Improve Manual Tasks.

modules.description: Why AI is built for repetitive work. The three levels of improvement — do the work, build a tool, redesign the process — and where the time really goes in a finance function.

lessons.content: By the end of this module, you will have used AI to take a repetitive, manual task from your work and make it significantly faster — either by having AI do the work directly, by having it create a tool or template you can reuse, or by having it redesign the process entirely. This is where AI goes from helpful to transformative.
lessons.title: What You'll Accomplish

lessons.content:
Pick a task from your work that is manual, repetitive, and time-consuming. It should be something you do regularly — weekly, monthly, or every close cycle. The best candidates are tasks where you're doing the same type of work over and over with different data.

**The default example used throughout this module is:**

> **Monthly journal entry preparation** — gathering data from multiple sources, formatting it, creating the journal entry template, and documenting the support.

If you're not sure what to pick, use this default. Otherwise, choose your own task and follow along with the same steps.
lessons.title: Choose Your Task

lessons.content:
You need access to at least one AI platform. All three below offer free tiers — pick whichever you'd like, or try more than one.

| Tool | Link | What It Is |
|------|------|------------|
| **ChatGPT** | https://chat.openai.com | OpenAI's AI assistant |
| **Claude** | https://claude.ai | Anthropic's AI assistant |
| **Grok** | https://grok.com | xAI's AI assistant |

For the **Bonus** section at the end, you'll also use:

| Tool | Link | What It Is |
|------|------|------------|
| **AI Gym** | https://aigym.studio/#download | Your training portfolio desktop app for creating and managing agents |

**Note:** For this module, it's especially useful to have a real example of the task you want to improve — a spreadsheet, a process document, an email chain, or even just a clear description of the steps you follow. The more concrete you are, the better AI can help.
lessons.title: Tools Needed

activities.title: What AI Is Good At: Doing Repetitive Work Consistently

lessons.content:
In the previous modules, you used AI to help you think (research), communicate (writing), and validate (review). Now you're going to use it for something that hits differently: **doing the tedious work itself.**

Every finance team has tasks that are necessary but painful — the ones that eat up hours every close cycle, the ones people dread, the ones where you think "there has to be a better way." Data formatting. Copy-paste workflows. Reconciliation prep. Report assembly. Template filling. The work isn't hard — it's just time-consuming and repetitive.

AI is built for this. It doesn't get bored, doesn't lose focus on row 347, and can process in seconds what takes you an hour.
lessons.title: What AI Is Good At: Doing Repetitive Work Consistently

lessons.content:
When you bring AI into a manual task, there are three levels of impact:

| Level | What Happens | Example |
|-------|-------------|---------|
| **Level 1: AI does the work** | You give AI the inputs, it produces the output | "Here's the data — create the journal entry" |
| **Level 2: AI creates a tool** | AI builds something you can reuse every time | "Create an Excel formula / template / checklist I can use monthly" |
| **Level 3: AI redesigns the process** | AI helps you rethink the entire workflow | "Here's how we do this today — how would you redesign it to be faster?" |

All three levels are valuable. Level 1 saves you time right now. Level 2 saves you time forever. Level 3 might change how your team works.
lessons.title: The Three Levels of Improvement

lessons.content:
Finance professionals often underestimate how much time goes to manual work. Here's a typical breakdown for a monthly close process:

| Activity | % of Time | AI Can Help? |
|----------|-----------|-------------|
| Gathering data from different sources | 25% | Yes — AI can process and combine data |
| Formatting data into the right structure | 20% | Yes — AI is excellent at reformatting |
| Creating entries, templates, or reports | 20% | Yes — AI can generate these from inputs |
| Reviewing and checking the work | 15% | Yes — covered in Module 3 |
| Documenting support and explanations | 10% | Yes — covered in Module 2 |
| Actual judgment and decision-making | 10% | This is you — AI supports, you decide |

That means roughly 90% of your time is spent on things AI can help with. The 10% that requires your judgment? That's where your value is. AI frees you to spend more time there.
lessons.title: Where the Time Goes

modules.title: Context / Theory

modules.description: Hands-on steps. Describe a manual task, have AI improve it at all three levels, and apply the same approach to a second task.

lessons.content:
Go to one of the platforms listed above and sign in.

- **ChatGPT** — https://chat.openai.com
- **Claude** — https://claude.ai
- **Grok** — https://grok.com
lessons.title: Step 1: Open an AI Tool

lessons.content:
First, you're going to tell AI exactly how you do this task today — step by step. This is important because AI can't improve what it doesn't understand.

> **Try this (default example):**
> "Every month I prepare a journal entry for accrued expenses. Here's my current process:
> 1. I get a report from the AP team showing invoices received but not yet processed
> 2. I get a second report from procurement showing POs with goods received but no invoice
> 3. I manually combine these into a spreadsheet, removing duplicates
> 4. I categorize each item by GL account based on the PO category
> 5. I sum the amounts by GL account
> 6. I create the journal entry — debit the expense accounts, credit accrued liabilities
> 7. I format it in our standard JE template with the entry description, support, and approver
> 8. I save the supporting documentation
>
> This process takes me about 2 hours each month. Can you help me make it faster?"

If you chose your own task, describe it the same way — walk AI through every step of your current process.
lessons.title: Step 2: Describe Your Manual Task

activities.title: Step 3: Let AI Improve It (Level 1 — Do the Work)

lessons.content:
Now give AI actual data (or sample data) and ask it to do the work:

> **Try this:**
> "Here's sample data from both reports [paste or describe]. Can you:
> 1. Combine the two data sets and remove duplicates
> 2. Categorize each item by GL account using this mapping: [provide your mapping or ask AI to suggest one]
> 3. Sum the amounts by GL account
> 4. Create the journal entry in this format: [describe your format]
> 5. Write the journal entry description"

Watch AI process the data, combine it, categorize it, and produce the journal entry — with a description and support. The work that takes you 2 hours took AI about 30 seconds.
lessons.title: Step 3: Let AI Improve It (Level 1 — Do the Work)

activities.title: Step 4: Have AI Create a Reusable Tool (Level 2 — Build a Tool)

lessons.content:
Now level it up. Instead of having AI do this manually each month, ask it to create something you can reuse:

> **Try this:**
> "This is great. Now can you create a reusable template that I can use every month? I want:
> 1. An Excel template where I paste the two reports, and it automatically combines them, removes duplicates, categorizes by GL account, and calculates the journal entry
> 2. Include the formulas and formatting I'd need
> 3. Add a summary tab that shows the journal entry ready to post
> 4. Include a documentation section I can print as support"

AI will generate the formulas, the template structure, and the instructions. Depending on the platform, it may create a downloadable file or give you step-by-step instructions to build it yourself.

**Alternative tools AI can create:**
- **A Python script** that processes the reports automatically
- **A step-by-step procedure** with built-in quality checks
- **A checklist** with conditional logic (if X, then do Y)
- **Email templates** for recurring communications related to the task
lessons.title: Step 4: Have AI Create a Reusable Tool (Level 2 — Build a Tool)

activities.title: Step 5: Rethink the Process (Level 3 — Redesign It)

lessons.content:
Now ask AI to step back and look at the whole process:

> **Try this:**
> "Looking at this entire monthly accrual process — gathering data, combining reports, categorizing, creating the entry, documenting support — how would you redesign it if you were starting from scratch? What steps could be eliminated, automated, or combined? Where are the biggest opportunities to save time?"

AI will often suggest improvements you haven't considered — like getting the data in a different format upfront, creating a standing template that only needs new numbers each month, or building a simple validation check that catches errors before the entry is posted.

This is Level 3 thinking. You're not just doing the work faster — you're doing it differently.
lessons.title: Step 5: Rethink the Process (Level 3 — Redesign It)

activities.title: Step 6: Apply It to Another Task

lessons.content:
Now pick a second task from your work and run through the same process. This time, you'll be faster because you know the pattern.

**Common finance tasks that benefit from this approach:**

| Task | What AI Can Do |
|------|---------------|
| **Bank reconciliation prep** | Format the bank statement, match it against the GL, flag unmatched items |
| **Intercompany reconciliation** | Compare IC balances across entities, identify mismatches, draft the elimination entry |
| **Fixed asset roll-forward** | Take the prior month balance, add additions and disposals, calculate depreciation, produce the roll-forward |
| **Revenue schedule updates** | Update deferred revenue schedules with new contracts and monthly recognition amounts |
| **Expense report review** | Check expense reports against policy limits and flag violations |
| **Flux analysis** | Compare current month to prior month and budget, calculate variances, draft explanations for the top movers |
| **Close checklist updates** | Take the close checklist and pre-populate it with dates, owners, and status based on the current cycle |

Pick one, describe your current process to AI, and let it help you improve it.
lessons.title: Step 6: Apply It to Another Task

lessons.content:
You just used AI to improve a manual task. Think about the experience:

- How much time could this save you per month? Per year?
- Which level of improvement was most impactful — doing the work (Level 1), creating a tool (Level 2), or redesigning the process (Level 3)?
- What other tasks in your work could benefit from this approach?
- Were there any parts of the process where you realized AI couldn't help — where your judgment was essential?

That last point matters. The goal isn't to automate everything — it's to automate the parts that don't need you, so you have more time for the parts that do.
lessons.title: Step 7: Reflect

modules.title: Now To Do

modules.description: Every area of the finance function where AI can eliminate manual work — close, reporting, data tasks, process documentation, and team efficiency.

lessons.content:
- **Journal entry preparation:** The example we walked through. Any recurring journal entry that follows a pattern — accruals, reclasses, allocations, eliminations — can be templated and partially automated with AI.

- **Reconciliation preparation:** Instead of manually formatting bank statements and GL exports to match, have AI do the formatting and initial matching. You review the exceptions.

- **Close checklist management:** Have AI pre-populate your close checklist with dates, owners, and standard tasks based on the period. You update it with actual status as you go.

- **Flux analysis narratives:** Give AI the variance data and ask it to draft explanations. You review and add the context that requires judgment.
lessons.title: Monthly Close

lessons.content:
- **Management reporting:** If you build the same report every month with different numbers, have AI create a template or process that generates the report from updated data.

- **Board pack preparation:** Assemble board materials faster by having AI compile sections, format tables, and draft narrative summaries from your inputs.

- **Regulatory reporting:** For recurring filings with standard formats, have AI help pre-populate fields from your data and flag any items that need manual review.
lessons.title: Recurring Reporting

lessons.content:
- **Data cleanup:** Messy data from exports, imports, or manual entry. Give AI a sample and tell it what "clean" looks like — it can generate formulas, scripts, or instructions to fix common issues.

- **Format conversion:** Converting data from one system's format to another. AI can write the transformation logic — VLOOKUP formulas, Power Query steps, or simple scripts.

- **Report consolidation:** Combining reports from multiple entities, departments, or systems into a single view. AI handles the merging and formatting.
lessons.title: Data Tasks

lessons.content:
- **SOP creation:** Walk AI through how you do something, and ask it to create a standard operating procedure with screenshots-ready steps, decision points, and quality checks.

- **Process mapping:** Describe a workflow and have AI create a step-by-step process map identifying inputs, outputs, owners, and systems at each step.

- **Training materials:** When you need to train someone on a process, have AI draft the training document based on your description of the steps.
lessons.title: Process Documentation

lessons.content:
- **Workload distribution:** Describe your team's tasks and AI can help map them, identify bottlenecks, and suggest how to redistribute work.

- **Template standardization:** Have AI review the various templates your team uses and create standardized versions with consistent formatting and built-in quality checks.

- **Email automation:** For recurring communications — close kickoff emails, reminder messages, status requests — have AI create templates with variable fields you fill in each cycle.
lessons.title: Team Efficiency

modules.title: Application

modules.description: Optional. Build a Finance Process Optimizer agent that understands your environment and finds efficiency improvements on demand.

lessons.content:
*This section is optional. It takes the basic skill you just learned — using AI to improve manual tasks — and levels it up by creating a dedicated automation agent.*

In the main exercise, you described individual tasks and had AI improve them one at a time. But what if you had an agent that already understands your processes, your systems, and the types of tasks you deal with? An agent you can go to whenever you're thinking "there has to be a better way" and it immediately helps you find it.
lessons.title: The Idea

lessons.content: An **automation agent** — an AI assistant that specializes in analyzing your manual tasks and finding ways to make them faster, simpler, or automatic.
lessons.title: What You'll Create

activities.title: Option A: Create a Project in ChatGPT

lessons.content:
1. Go to **https://chat.openai.com** and sign in
2. In the sidebar, click **Explore GPTs** → **Create**
3. In the **Configure** tab:
   - **Name:** `Finance Process Optimizer` (or your preferred name)
   - **Description:** `Expert assistant for streamlining manual finance tasks`
   - **Instructions:** Paste the following (modify for your role):

```
You are my dedicated process improvement agent. I work in a finance function and need help making manual, repetitive tasks faster and more efficient.

When I describe a task or process:
- First, make sure you understand every step. Ask clarifying questions if needed.
- Identify which steps are manual, repetitive, and time-consuming
- Suggest improvements at three levels:
  1. Level 1 (Do it): You do the work for me right now with the data I provide
  2. Level 2 (Build a tool): Create something reusable — a template, formula, script, or checklist I can use every time
  3. Level 3 (Redesign it): Suggest how to restructure the entire process to eliminate unnecessary steps

My environment:
- I primarily use Excel/Google Sheets, email, and our ERP system
- I'm comfortable with formulas but not a programmer — keep scripts simple and well-documented if you suggest them
- I work in a monthly close cycle with recurring tasks
- Changes need to be practical — I can't overhaul entire systems, but I can change how I personally do the work

When creating tools or templates:
- Include clear instructions for how to use them
- Add validation checks where possible
- Make them robust enough for someone else on my team to use
- Default to Excel unless I specify otherwise

Always quantify the potential time savings when you suggest an improvement.
```

4. Click **Save** → Choose **Only me**
lessons.title: Option A: Create a Project in ChatGPT

activities.title: Option B: Create a Project in Claude

lessons.content:
1. Go to **https://claude.ai** and sign in
2. In the sidebar, click **Projects** → **Create a project**
3. Give it a name: `Finance Process Optimizer`
4. In the **Project instructions** field, paste the same instructions from Option A
5. Click **Create project**
lessons.title: Option B: Create a Project in Claude

activities.title: Option C: Create a Conversation in Grok

lessons.content:
1. Go to **https://grok.com** and sign in
2. Start a **new conversation**
3. As your first message, paste the instructions from Option A, prefixed with: "For all conversations in this thread, please follow these instructions:"
4. Bookmark this conversation
lessons.title: Option C: Create a Conversation in Grok

activities.title: Option D: Create an Agent in AI Gym

lessons.content:
1. Open the **AI Gym** app and sign in (if not yet downloaded: https://aigym.studio/#download) — you'll land on the **Home** page (your Hub agent)
2. On Home, type: *"Create an agent called Finance Process Optimizer in my My Training Portfolio org with these instructions:"* and paste the instructions from Option A
3. The Hub creates it for you. Or go to the **Org** page → My Training Portfolio → **+ New Agent**

Your automation agent is now part of your training portfolio alongside your research, communications, and review agents.
lessons.title: Option D: Create an Agent in AI Gym

lessons.content:
Go to the **Home** page and chat with your **Using AI Series Agent** to update it:

> "I just completed Module 4. I created a Finance Process Optimizer agent. I learned how to use AI to improve manual tasks at three levels — doing the work, building reusable tools, and redesigning processes. I improved my [task name] process and the estimated time savings is [X hours per month]. The biggest takeaway was [your takeaway]."

Your portfolio now has **four working agents**: a research expert, a communications writer, a review analyst, and a process optimizer.
lessons.title: Build on Your Portfolio

lessons.content:
You now have a **dedicated automation agent** that:
- Understands your work environment and constraints
- Analyzes any manual task and suggests three levels of improvement
- Creates reusable tools — templates, formulas, checklists, scripts
- Helps you redesign processes from the ground up
- Quantifies the time savings so you can prioritize what to improve next
lessons.title: What You've Built

modules.title: Bonus: Going Deeper

modules.description: Key terms introduced in this module, explained in plain language.

lessons.content: Making a process happen with less manual work. In AI terms, this ranges from having AI do a task for you (basic automation) to having AI create tools that do the work on their own (advanced automation). You don't need to be a programmer to automate — AI can create the tools for you.
lessons.title: Automation

lessons.content: A pre-built structure you reuse with different data each time. AI can create templates for journal entries, reports, checklists, emails, and more. A good template has built-in formulas, formatting, and validation — so each time you use it, you just add the data.
lessons.title: Template

lessons.content: A small program that automates a specific task — like reformatting data, matching records, or generating a report. AI can write scripts in languages like Python or VBA (Excel macros). You don't need to understand the code — AI explains how to run it and what it does.
lessons.title: Script

lessons.content: Documenting each step of a workflow — who does what, in what order, with what tools, and what the output is. This is the foundation for improving any process: you have to see it clearly before you can make it better.
lessons.title: Process Mapping

lessons.content: Measuring how long each step of a process takes. When AI helps you improve a task, the time savings is the most tangible metric. If a 2-hour monthly task becomes a 20-minute task, that's 20+ hours per year returned to higher-value work.
lessons.title: Time Study

lessons.content: The end-to-end sequence of steps that makes up a business process — from trigger to completion. AI can help you see, document, and improve entire workflows, not just individual steps.
lessons.title: Workflow
